registration reset was not confirmed.zh-CN: 请先确认重置登录。此操作会让用户退出登录，并更换注册链接。

replacement enrollment was not created.en: The replacement enrollment link could not be created. Check the Server status and Master logs, then retry.
replacement enrollment was not created.zh-CN: 未能创建替换设备的注册链接。请检查服务器状态和主控端日志，然后重试。

replacement result could not be prepared.en: The replacement link was not displayed. Check the Server's enrollment state before creating a new replacement link.
replacement result could not be prepared.zh-CN: 替换设备的注册链接未能显示。请先检查服务器的注册状态，再决定是否创建新链接。

request form is invalid.en: The form contains missing, duplicate, or unsupported fields. Check your input; if this page was open during an update, reopen the form.
request form is invalid.zh-CN: 表单存在缺失、重复或不受支持的字段。请检查输入；如果页面在系统更新前就已打开，请重新打开表单。

request host is not configured.en: This address is not configured for the Master. Open the public URL configured during installation.
request host is not configured.zh-CN: 此地址不是主控端配置的访问地址，请使用安装时设置的公开网址。

request was not authorized.en: The request could not be authorized. Keep your input, sign in again in another tab, then reload this page if necessary.
request was not authorized.zh-CN: 请求未通过安全验证。请保留当前输入，在另一个标签页重新登录；如仍无法提交，再刷新此页。

routing Rule contains an invalid value.en: One or more match values are invalid for the selected type. Check domain names, CIDRs, protocol names, and regular expressions.
routing Rule contains an invalid value.zh-CN: 部分匹配值不适用于所选类型，请检查域名、CIDR、协议名称或正则表达式。

routing Rule requires match values.en: Enter at least one value for this match type, or choose ALL for a fallback branch.
routing Rule requires match values.zh-CN: 请为此匹配类型填写至少一个值，或选择 ALL 创建兜底分支。

routing target is invalid.en: Choose an available target or DIRECT / REJECT.
routing target is invalid.zh-CN: 请选择可用的目标，或选择 DIRECT（直连）/ REJECT（拒绝）。

self-signed TLS requires a valid server.en: Enter a valid domain name or IP address for the self-signed certificate.
self-signed TLS requires a valid server.zh-CN: 请输入有效的域名或 IP 地址，用于自签名证书。

server access could not be revoked.en: Server removal could not be completed. Check whether it still appears in Servers before retrying, and inspect the Master logs.
server access could not be revoked.zh-CN: 服务器移除操作未能完成。请先确认它是否仍在列表中，并检查主控端日志，再决定是否重试。

server details could not be loaded.en: Server details could not be loaded. Return to Servers and retry; check the Master logs if the problem continues.
server details could not be loaded.zh-CN: 未能加载服务器详情。请返回服务器列表后重试；如果仍有问题，请检查主控端日志。

sing-box update control is unavailable u.en: sing-box update control is unavailable until this server is online with a compatible agent.
sing-box update control is unavailable u.zh-CN: 服务器上线并运行兼容代理端后，才能使用 sing-box 更新控制。

sing-box update could not be prepared.en: The sing-box update request could not be saved. Check the Master logs and available disk space before retrying.
sing-box update could not be prepared.zh-CN: sing-box 更新请求未能保存。请检查主控端日志和剩余磁盘空间后重试。

subscription could not be rendered.en: This client profile could not be generated. Ask the administrator to check this user's applied Nodes and subscription rules.
subscription could not be rendered.zh-CN: 未能生成客户端配置。请联系管理员检查此用户已应用的节点配置及订阅规则。

subscription duration is invalid or exce.en: Enter a positive subscription duration of no more than 100 years.
subscription duration is invalid or exce.zh-CN: 请输入大于 0 且不超过 100 年的订阅时长。

subscription reset was not confirmed.en: Confirm subscription reset. This replaces the subscription URL and all Node credentials for this user.
subscription reset was not confirmed.zh-CN: 请先确认重置订阅。此操作会更换该用户的订阅链接及所有节点凭据。

target Agent has no routable address.en: The target Server has no public IP address. Check its connection or set a public IPv4/IPv6 override in Server settings.
target Agent has no routable address.zh-CN: 目标服务器没有可用的公网 IP。请检查连接状态，或在服务器设置中填写公网 IPv4 / IPv6 地址。

target Agent is unavailable.en: This target Server is unavailable. Select an existing enrolled Server.
target Agent is unavailable.zh-CN: 目标服务器不可用，请选择已注册且仍存在的服务器。

terminal exit must be Direct or Reject.en: Choose DIRECT to connect directly or REJECT to block unmatched traffic.
terminal exit must be Direct or Reject.zh-CN: 请选择 DIRECT（直连）或 REJECT（拒绝），决定如何处理未匹配的流量。

terminal target must be Direct or Reject.en: Choose DIRECT or REJECT as the terminal action.
terminal target must be Direct or Reject.zh-CN: 请选择 DIRECT（直连）或 REJECT（拒绝）作为终端动作。

the IPv4 override must be an IPv4 addres.en: Enter a public IPv4 address, or leave this field empty for automatic detection.
the IPv4 override must be an IPv4 addres.zh-CN: 请输入公网 IPv4 地址，或留空以自动检测。

the IPv6 override must be an IPv6 addres.en: Enter a public IPv6 address, or leave this field empty for automatic detection.
the IPv6 override must be an IPv6 addres.zh-CN: 请输入公网 IPv6 地址，或留空以自动检测。

the address override could not be saved.en: The public address could not be saved. Check the Master logs and state-directory permissions, then try again.
the address override could not be saved.zh-CN: 公网地址未能保存。请检查主控端日志和状态目录权限，然后重试。

the latest release could not be determin.en: The signed release catalog could not be loaded. Check the Master's access to GitHub, then choose Check again.
the latest release could not be determin.zh-CN: 未能加载签名版本目录。请检查主控端能否访问 GitHub，然后点击“重新检查”。

the outbound pool is unavailable.en: The outbound pool is unavailable. Check the Master startup logs and reload the Pool page.
the outbound pool is unavailable.zh-CN: 出口池暂不可用。请检查主控端启动日志，然后刷新出口池页面。

the pool entry could not be deleted.en: The pool entry could not be deleted. Check its current state and the Master logs before trying again.
the pool entry could not be deleted.zh-CN: 出口池条目未能删除。请先核实条目当前状态并检查主控端日志，再重试。

the server must be enrolled first.en: Install and enroll this Server's Agent before changing its network settings.
the server must be enrolled first.zh-CN: 请先安装并注册此服务器的代理端，再修改网络设置。

the subscription domains could not be sa.en: Subscription domains could not be saved. Check the domain format and Master logs before trying again.
the subscription domains could not be sa.zh-CN: 订阅域名未能保存。请检查域名格式及主控端日志后重试。

too many enrollment credentials were cre.en: Too many enrollment links were created recently. Wait one minute before creating another.
too many enrollment credentials were cre.zh-CN: 最近创建的注册链接过多，请等待一分钟后再创建。

unauthorized.en: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
unauthorized.zh-CN: 登录已过期，请重新登录后继续。

unknown rule-set catalog.en: Choose the Geosite or GeoIP catalog.
unknown rule-set catalog.zh-CN: 请选择 Geosite 或 GeoIP 规则集目录。

unknown version catalog.en: This version catalog is not supported. Reopen Settings or Server settings and choose an available component.
unknown version catalog.zh-CN: 不支持此版本目录。请重新打开系统设置或服务器设置，选择可用组件。

unsupported routing match type.en: Choose a supported match type from the rule editor.
unsupported routing match type.zh-CN: 请在规则编辑器中选择受支持的匹配类型。

update status could not be loaded.en: Update status could not be loaded. Check whether the update is still running before scheduling another one.
update status could not be loaded.zh-CN: 未能读取更新状态。请先确认更新是否仍在进行，再决定是否重新安排更新。

upload Mbps must be a positive number.en: Enter an upload bandwidth greater than 0, in Mbps.
upload Mbps must be a positive number.zh-CN: 请输入大于 0 的上传带宽，单位为 Mbps。

user manager is unavailable.en: User management is unavailable. Check the Master startup logs and reload this page.
user manager is unavailable.zh-CN: 用户管理暂不可用。请检查主控端启动日志，然后刷新此页。

username must contain between 1 and 64 A.en: username must contain between 1 and 64 ASCII characters
username must contain between 1 and 64 A.zh-CN: 登录名须包含 1 至 64 个 ASCII 字符。

username must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{.zh-CN: 登录名只能使用小写字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符，且必须以字母或数字开头。

when you are ready to migrate it..en: when you are ready to migrate it.
